title: crataegus azarolus var. sinaica
intro: Crataegus azarolus var. sinaica, commonly known as Sina hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, native to the Middle East and North Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing blood pressure, lowering cholesterol levels, and alleviating symptoms of heart failure and angina. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus azarolus var. sinaica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective effects. The health benefits of Crataegus azarolus var. sinaica are also attributed to its ability to improve cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system.
